        c.customer_id,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_payment,

    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id

    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
      AND ft.transaction_date >= '2018-03-01'
      AND ft.transaction_date < '2018-04-01'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id, account_ids
FROM payment_data
ORDER BY total_payment DESC
LIMIT 5;

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
    SELECT
        transaction_id AS trans_id,
        previous_transaction_id,
        transaction_id AS root_id,
        0 AS depth
    FROM Financial_Transactions
    WHERE previous_transaction_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ft.transaction_id,
        ft.previous_transaction_id,
        c.root_id,
        c.depth + 1
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN chain c ON ft.previous_transaction_id = c.trans_id
)
SELECT
    a.account_name,
    ft.transaction_id,
    ft.transaction_type,
    ft.transaction_date,
    ft.transaction_amount,
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ft.account_id ORDER BY ft.transaction_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total,
    c.root_id AS chain_root_id,
    c.depth
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN chain c ON ft.transaction_id = c.trans_id
ORDER BY a.account_name, ft.transaction_date;
